summary: @or-sdk/sdk-api preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727 KB payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (hex-mangled identifiers _0x488df8/_0x52943e/_0x548d91, per-function property-map indirection for fs/https/zlib). When Bun is not already present, it downloads the Bun runtime ZIP from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts and chmods the binary (mode 0755), then invokes that binary to execute the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript file (sha256 9fc2570b...) using classic string-array rotation (WV8StW-style shift decoder, large numeric/string constant table, _0xNNNN identifiers). The package's src/ tree only contains a small TypeScript HTTP SDK (SdkApi.ts, constants.ts, index.ts, types.ts) that does not build or reference math_init.js, and an HTTP SDK client has no functional need for an alternate language runtime. Installing the package therefore auto-executes an opaque bundled payload through a freshly downloaded second runtime, and the payload's actual behavior cannot be determined from source.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
